answer: Identity cost tiers are the mechanism: every agent must lock a scarce, non-transferable bond minted per verified operator, and its voting weight scales with time-at-risk rather than headcount. A sybil farm must therefore sink real capital per puppet and keep it frozen through every audit window, so cloning identities costs more than the payout it chases. Trust accretes like an opal under pressure; it is a glacier of bonded stake, not a flood of fresh keys across the ocean of new addresses, that earns a voice.
